title: Compact closed category
html:
Remark. Compact closed category

Compact closed category. A symmetric monoidal category that is also rigid. Since the braiding identifies X \otimes Y \cong Y \otimes X, left duals and right duals coincide.

Mathlib reference. CategoryTheory.CompactClosedCategory (class). Import: Mathlib.CategoryTheory.Closed.Monoidal.
